title: Kitten in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#e8935a"/>
  <!-- kitten head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="20" fill="#f0a868"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points="34,30 30,12 44,24" fill="#f0a868"/>
  <polygon points="66,30 70,12 56,24" fill="#f0a868"/>
  <polygon points="36,28 33,17 43,25" fill="#f7c4a0"/>
  <polygon points="64,28 67,17 57,25" fill="#f7c4a0"/>
  <!-- inner face lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#fbcfa8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="43" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#3b6ea5"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="43" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#3b6ea5"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="42" r="1.4" fill="#a8d8f0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="42" r="1.4" fill="#a8d8f0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points="50,50 47.5,47 52.5,47" fill="#e0607e"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 50 Q46 54 43 52" stroke="#c94a66" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 50 Q54 54 57 52" stroke="#c94a66" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="28" y1="46" x2="38" y2="48" stroke="#f7c4a0" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="28" y1="52" x2="38" y2="51" stroke="#f7c4a0" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="46" x2="62" y2="48" stroke="#f7c4a0" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="52" x2="62" y2="51" stroke="#f7c4a0" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x="34" y="60" width="32" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#e8434f"/>
  <rect x="34" y="63" width="32" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#f57a83"/>
  <rect x="55" y="65" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#e8434f"/>
  <rect x="56" y="72" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#f57a83"/>
  <rect x="56" y="76" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#f57a83"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#fbcfa8"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#fbcfa8"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M70 78 Q86 74 84 62" stroke="#e8935a" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M84 62 Q83 58 85 56" stroke="#f7c4a0" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
